guide.summary: Temples, gardens, a free art museum and New Delhi's hotel restaurants, bars and patisseries, checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Swaminarayan Akshardham and the Kiran Nadar Museum of Art (Saket) are both closed on Mondays, and Akshardham does not allow phones, cameras or bags inside, so use its free cloakroom before the security queue.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Swaminarayan Akshardham and the Kiran Nadar Museum of Art (Saket) are both closed on Mondays. Sunder Nursery says it opens seven days a week.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Kiran Nadar Museum of Art admission is free, but you register at reception; Akshardham's mandir is free and its exhibitions cost ₹260 for adults. Jamavar at The Leela Palace and Dhilli at The Oberoi both recommend advance reservations.

toolkit.label: Bags and security
toolkit.copy: Akshardham bans phones, cameras, bags, food and umbrellas and offers a free cloakroom. At KNMA, large bags are left at reception against a token.

toolkit.label: Dress and age rules
toolkit.copy: The Library Bar admits only patrons over 25 and asks for smart casuals, while Cirrus 9 allows under-25s until 8.00 pm and requires full-length trousers and closed shoes for men. At Akshardham, clothing must cover shoulders and upper arms and reach below the knees.

guide.dek: Plan around the Monday closures at Akshardham and KNMA, start early in the gardens, and book hotel dining rooms ahead for the evening.
intro: This Delhi guide is built around places whose own websites you can check before you go. Swaminarayan Akshardham on NH 24 is open Tuesday to Sunday, with first entry at 10:00 am and last entry at 6:30 pm, and it is closed every Monday. Mandir entry and darshan are free, while the three exhibitions cost ₹260 for adults. Security is strict: phones, cameras, bags and food are not allowed, so you leave them in the free cloakroom, and your clothing must cover your upper arms and reach below the knee.

For art, the Kiran Nadar Museum of Art in DLF South Court Mall, Saket, is free, open Tuesday to Sunday from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM and closed on Mondays. You register at reception, and large bags stay there. Two exhibitions, Inheritors of Earth and In-Rhythm, which pairs Bice Lazzari and Nasreen Mohamedi, run from 9 September to 22 December 2026. At Rashtrapati Bhavan, the visit website lists working hours of Tuesday to Sunday, 9:00 to 16:00, and notes that Museum Phase II remains closed until further notice.

Green space is easy to fit in. Sunder Nursery in Nizamuddin opens from 7am to 10pm, seven days a week, with last entry at 9:00 pm, though its Garden House, Museum and Restaurant blocks are under construction and not accessible. NDMC lists Lodhi Garden on Lodhi Road as closing at 8.00 PM. For breakfast, The Qube at The Leela Palace runs a buffet from 6:30 am to 10:30 am, and 1911 Restaurant at The Imperial opens at 6:30am. Third Wave Coffee at DLF Midtown Plaza serves from 9:30 AM daily.

Evenings centre on hotel dining rooms and bars. Bukhara and Dum Pukht at ITC Maurya serve lunch from 12:30 and dinner from 19:00, and Dum Pukht admits children above the age of 8 at dinner. Jamavar at The Leela Palace recommends booking ahead, while Dhilli at The Oberoi does not allow children under 13 after 9:00 pm. For drinks, The Library Bar admits only patrons over 25, and Cirrus 9 lets under-25s in until 8.00 pm, with full-length trousers and closed shoes required for men.
summaryCards: Start at Swaminarayan Akshardham on any day but Monday, leaving your phone in its free cloakroom, and finish with dinner at Bukhara or Indian Accent.
Walk Lodhi Garden or Sunder Nursery, which opens at 7am, then take the 6:30 am to 10:30 am breakfast buffet at The Qube.
Akshardham and the Kiran Nadar Museum of Art are closed on Mondays, and Jamavar and Dhilli recommend reserving ahead.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. The ASI pages for Humayun's Tomb, Qutub Minar and Red Fort were readable but gave no address, so those monuments are left out. Sites that could not be read: National Museum (certificate error), NGMA New Delhi (404/no content), Lotus Temple and Pradhanmantri Sangrahalaya (403), Gandhi Smriti (expired certificate), National Rail Museum (connection refused), Karim's (fetch failed), Blue Tokai (429), Taj Mahal New Delhi (403), The Big Chill Cafe and L'Opera (domains did not resolve). The nscdelhi.org domain no longer serves the National Science Centre. Indian Accent, Safari Lounge and Lodhi Bakery publish no opening hours; Rashtrapati Bhavan's hours come from its contact page, not individual circuit pages; Baoshuan's hours come from the hotel's dining list, which differs slightly from Dhilli's own page on weekend lunch times. Lodhi Garden opening times vary by season on the NDMC page.
